result.topic_en: A printed hotel bill from the Hôtel de Russie in Hannover (1855) made out to Dr. Riemann of Göttingen, reused for pencil calculations: an asymptotic expansion of a Riccati-type equation, plus further formulas and geometric sketches, some written upside down.
result.transcription:
Hannover 1855
Hôtel de Russie.
RECHNUNG
für Herrn Dr. Riemann aus Göttingen
von Julius Meese. [?] Schafgraben[?]
№ 30
Auslagen
April
Transport . .
17 1/2 Bier 1 Mittag[?] . 14
1/2 Rhwein, 1 Abendessen[?] . 15
1/4 Barsac, 1 Licht . 7
1 Logis . 10
18 1 Portkaffee[?] [?] . 5
1 Frühstück . 6
1/2 Forster . 10
Service . 4
Th 2. 23 ggr
Pr acquit
Julius Meese

[pencil, upright:]
$v^2+\frac{\partial v}{\partial e} = g^2\psi(\lambda)^2$
$v = g\psi(\lambda) + v_1$
$2g\psi(\lambda)v_1 + v_1^2 + \frac{\partial v_1}{\partial e} + g\psi'(\lambda)\frac{\partial \lambda}{\partial e}$
$v_1 = -\frac{1}{2}\frac{\psi'(\lambda)}{\psi(\lambda)}\frac{\partial\lambda}{\partial e}$

[pencil, upside down, largely illegible: formulas involving $\log$, $\int e^{xu}\ldots$, sums $\sum$, fractions; small geometric sketches with numbers]

methods.what: Riccati-type differential equation in v with respect to e
Substitution splitting off the leading-order term (asymptotic expansion in large g)
Resulting equation for the correction term
First-order correction term obtained by balancing the order-g terms
